a bare multi-word dish name is English: no words around it to judge, and the name is a loanword. Single-word names never reach the model (the ASCII short-circuit), so multi-word ones are where this broke — the detector answered mr

the boundary on the bare-name rule: it is about Latin letters only. A native script always sets lang, because choosing the script is itself writing in the language. Over-correcting this to en was the first attempt's regression.
